changes: Each complete native claw assembly is rotated about its native arm root toward the lowered source claw position; original loops and inner claw strokes retained.
The four native drawn leg strokes are spread to source-observed lateral reaches. They are simplifications of overlapping legs, not four verified foot contacts.
Two frozen agent-authored eyestalk strokes retain the source fold event, separately credited; they are not original native ink.
compatibility.limitations: Four drawn leg strokes plus2agent eyes, not full anatomical limb/contact tracking

review_note: Native identity passes; sampled source pose passes. Normal-speed playback is unrun/unapproved; the viewed still samples reveal no material identity or source framing/pose gap. Normal-speed motion remains unapproved; classifier unrun. No training ran.
assembly_summary: The same native eleven-stroke crab lowers both claw constructions and spreads its four drawn leg reaches over the visible sand. Two separately credited agent eyestalk strokes preserve the observed brief eye-fold event.
